# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as heavy and plump, a trait that makes her unsuitable in her peers' eyes for slim roles like a fairy queen.

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, arrogant, and sharp-tongued, often making sarcastic or malicious remarks about others. She possesses little creative imagination, but she is bold and never hesitant to speak her mind or challenge her classmates. Though she rarely displays overt warmth, she shows occasional friendliness or relief when severe harm is avoided.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

## History

Flossie Tulk attended school in Brierley under Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Thorne. She frequently clashed with Nell Harcourt, famously daring her to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Pembroke's kitchen roof, which resulted in Nell falling and injuring her ankle. Flossie won the top prize for knitted lace at an exhibition and joined the Regent's entrance class alongside her peers. After passing the Entrance exam by a narrow margin, she moved on to the Academy for higher studies. Unlike many of her classmates who became teachers upon graduating, Flossie chose to return to Regent's for another year. Prior to Nell and Hugh's departure for college, a send-off celebration was held at the Tulk home, where Flossie displayed uncharacteristic friendliness despite continuing her sarcastic commentary.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)_
